manifest.name: dsh-aurora-skin
manifest.description: Three hand-tuned skins for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): Aurora (deep navy + electric cyan + warm coral), Paper (cool white + deep teal, daytime reading), and Hologram (near-black + lime-cyan, terminal vibes). Pure --dsw-alias-* token system, no core patches, persisted in localStorage.
manifest.author: breaker505

bundle.text:
# dsh-aurora-skin profile patch layer — insert one loader entry for the plugin
# package. The browser half is picked up by dsh-client-modules through the
# package's dsh.client declaration (same shape as dsh-skin).
- insert:
    - id: aurora-skin
      name: 'dsh-aurora-skin'

readme.text:
> Three hand-tuned skins for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
> Pure `--dsw-alias-*` token system, no core patches, persisted in localStorage.

| ID | Name | Mode | Mood |
|----|------|------|------|
| `aurora` | Aurora 极光 | Dark | Deep midnight navy · electric cyan · warm coral — aurora over a precision control room |
| `paper`  | Paper 纸本 | Light | Cool paper white · deep teal — feels like a research paper, made for daytime reading |
| `hologram` | Hologram 全息 | Dark | Near-black · lime-cyan — distinctive terminal vibes, like a precision instrument |

All three palettes were tuned by hand against the DSH `--dsw-alias-*` token surface
(bg-base / layer-1..3 / overlay / border / label-* / brand / button / interactive /
markdown / sidebar / scrollbar). Every value is a concrete CSS color — no `var()`
indirection — so contrast holds across the whole UI.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add breaker505/dsh-aurora-skin
```

Or locally from this checkout:

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web
pnpm add file:path/to/dsh-aurora-skin
```

Or clone directly:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/breaker505/dsh-aurora-skin
```

Then add `"dsh-aurora-skin"` to the `dsh.profile.bundles` array in `package.json`
and restart `dsh web`.

Open **Settings → General → Aurora Skins** and pick a skin, or click
"Follow system" to revert to the built-in appearance.

The Aurora picker row is rendered **above** the dsh-skin row (slot order 15 vs 20),
so curated skins show up first.

- **Tokens, not code.** The plugin only writes `--dsw-alias-*` custom
  properties on `<body>`. No DOM mutations, no overrides of internal
  DSH components, no monkey-patches.
- **Reversible by design.** Selecting "Follow system" clears the
  override and the UI returns to the original DSH palette — there is
  no install-time patch to undo.
- **Hand-tuned palettes.** Each of the three themes was dialed in
  token-by-token for contrast on both surface and text roles, in
  light and dark modes.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/breaker505/dsh-aurora-skin
cd dsh-aurora-skin
pnpm install
```

The `lib/client.js` is hand-written CJS that wraps the runtime-loaded
factory via `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` — the same shape tsdown
emits for the shipped `ui-*` packages, but with no build step. Edit it
directly and reload `dsh web`.
